item.title: Nafau, Hungry Lion ink wage deal
item.description: Adolf Kaure The Namibia Food and Allied Workers Union (Nafau) and the fast-food chain Hungry Lion signed an agreement on Tuesday in Windhoek to increase wages and revise working conditions. item.title: Nzovhu kakere gelike kadipagere mukadi … nkarapamwe kuna kuzihundira ziliporeko mokukwama kwama yikasama yina kugendagura, siponga unene
item.description: Omugulugombashe – mukadi gonomvhura 46, kadogorokere moune una puko, mo Omugulugombashe momukunda gwaOmusati. item.title: Aishe opeenhele okudimbuluka efiku lemanguluko konooli
item.description: Auleria Wakudumo Oitukulwa aishe konooli oya holola kutya oye lilongekidila okudimbuluka efiku lemanguluko olo tali ka dimbulukiwa momafiku 21 Maalitsa oshilongo ashishe. item.title: Oshiwana sha lulilwa komapandaanda a dima mOngwediva
